recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. If the DeviceDispense.receiver short display is corrected, do it in HL7/oo-incubator; no further core change is needed for the FHIR-39049 reference targets.
issue_request: FHIR-39049 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Device issue asking that DeviceDispense support dispensing devices to Practitioners and RelatedPerson. The approved scope added Practitioner to DeviceDispense.subject, left RelatedPerson on subject for future discussion, and added DeviceDispense.receiver as a 0..1 Reference to Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Patient, RelatedPerson, and Location.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commit cd30bdc21a585df315499bb798385d72e2cf93ea applied the issue by adding Practitioner to DeviceDispense.subject and introducing DeviceDispense.receiver with Patient, Practitioner, RelatedPerson, Location, and PractitionerRole target profiles. The current inactive core copy still contains those targets; later FHIR-41413 changes added Group.
additional_context: Current core build scope no longer includes DeviceDispense. The active source/fhir.ini resource list has no devicedispense entry, commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed devicedispense from fhir.ini, and SupplyDelivery narrative now links DeviceDispense to the HL7 OO Incubator IG. The current HL7/oo-incubator DeviceDispense source also carries the FHIR-39049 target profiles. Both the inactive core copy and OO Incubator source still have a stale receiver short display that says medication, but that editorial cleanup belongs in the external IG rather than this core checkout.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The published commit is an empty external-repo audit explaining that the requested conformance change is already represented and that current DeviceDispense maintenance is outside the active FHIR core build.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied R6 issue that added Group to DeviceDispense.subject, DeviceDispense.receiver, and DeviceDispense.performer.actor, explaining the extra current target profile beyond FHIR-39049.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification DeviceDispense issue requiring Practitioner on subject and a receiver reference covering Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Patient, RelatedPerson, and Location.

evidence_items.summary: Minutes record that subject should include Practitioner, RelatedPerson was excluded from subject for further discussion, receiver should be added with Practitioner, Patient, Location, and RelatedPerson, and the motion passed 11-0-1.
evidence_items.learned: This confirms the intended scope and avoids over-applying RelatedPerson to subject.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-39049 commit added Practitioner to DeviceDispense.subject and introduced DeviceDispense.receiver with the requested reference targets.
evidence_items.learned: The R5 core source application was made before this reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: The inactive core copy has Practitioner on subject and Patient, Practitioner, RelatedPerson, Location, PractitionerRole, and later Group on receiver.
evidence_items.learned: The requested conformance targets are present in the copied source, but build scope must be checked before editing it.

evidence_items.summary: DeviceDispense is absent from the active current core resource list; the November 2025 commit removed devicedispense from fhir.ini.
evidence_items.learned: The DeviceDispense source folder is outside current core build scope, so a core source edit would not fix the active specification.
